input: Apply for a press pass for the local film festival

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing which specific festival and its press pass application process determines what steps, forms, and materials are actually required.
Whether the user is applying as an individual freelancer, on behalf of a publication, or for a team affects what credentials and affiliation details need to be provided.
The application deadline or how soon the festival starts determines how urgently the task needs to be completed and which steps to prioritize.
Understanding the user's existing press credentials or prior coverage history affects how they should frame their application and what proof they can provide.
Knowing whether the application is submitted online, by email, or in person dictates the immediate next action and tools needed.
The type of coverage the user plans to produce (written reviews, video, photography, podcasting) affects which access tier to apply for and what to highlight in the application.
Knowing what the user considers a successful outcome — full festival access, specific screenings, or interview opportunities — helps prioritize what to emphasize in the application.

gold.taskTitle: Apply for a press pass for the film festival
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to successfully apply for a press pass to gain media access to their local film festival.

questions.title: Which specific film festival are you applying to?

questions.title: Are you applying as a freelancer or for a publication?

questions.title: Does the festival accept applications online, by email, or in person?

questions.title: What type of coverage are you planning to produce?
